scenarios.name: Ascent: engine out
scenarios.briefing: Launch to an 80 km parking orbit. One engine of the core cluster fails 25 s after liftoff: spot it on the engine matrix, keep flying, decide whether orbit is still possible.

scenarios.name: Ascent: gimbal stuck, then telemetry lost
scenarios.briefing: Launch to orbit. The gimbals lock at stage 8; the telemetry drops above 30 km for the coast. Fly on what still works.

scenarios.name: Mun descent: false fuel alarm
scenarios.briefing: Brake out of low Mun orbit and land. A LOW FUEL caution comes on below 4 km: is it real? Cross-check before aborting.

scenarios.name: Docking: RCS dead, SAS switch stuck
scenarios.briefing: Dock with the target. The SAS switch is stuck from the start and the RCS quads fail when the range is under 50 m (inject it by hand).

scenarios.name: Coast: loss of signal
scenarios.briefing: Coast to apoapsis and circularise. The radio link is lost at once: the PAD must come from the crew's own numbers.
